info.title: Fiscal Note Workbench API
info.description: REST API for the DOR fiscal note proof of concept. All paths are served under /api/v1.

get.summary: Current principal
Known users (for assignment pickers), optionally filtered by role
Start OIDC login (redirect)
OIDC callback
End session and redirect to the app
Liveness and dependency health
Audit log query
Parse a bill reference and resolve it to a bill and version
List bills (paged)
Bill summary with version list, hearings, prior fiscal notes, companion
Bill Document for one version (code=current resolves to the newest)
One section of a version
Version-to-version diff (to may be amend:{amendmentId} for a striking amendment)
Amendments of a bill
Amendment Document
Hearings and executive sessions
Upcoming hearings across bills inside a window (default: next 72 hours)
Ingest run history

post.summary: Start an ingest run (legiscan dataset path or refresh)

get.summary: Text search with direct-hit resolution, filters, facets (research/search.md section 6.1)
Search-as-you-type suggestions
List templates
Template with HTML body

put.summary: Update a template (template_editor role); creates a new template version

get.summary: Template rendered with a note's token context
Base template token context for the session
Reference data set (fiscal-years, accounts, revenue-sources, job-classes, phrases, wac-458)

post.summary: Create a note and its first revision for a bill version (or amendment)

get.summary: List note revisions visible to the caller
Note revisions on this bill visible to the caller, grouped by version
Note revision summary (bill, version, request, workflow state, deadlines, assignees)

patch.summary: Update metadata (confidential flag, priority, request fields, identifier override per B.RFA.03)

get.summary: Template token context for this note revision

post.summary: Create the next revision for a new bill version or amendment, cloning the document

get.summary: Head document

put.summary: Save head document (autosave). Requires If-Match with the current version.

get.summary: Document versions (autosave heads and named snapshots)

post.summary: Name a snapshot of the head

get.summary: A stored document version

post.summary: Restore a version as the new head

get.summary: Redline between two document versions plus a table-cell diff
Validate the head document (required slots, table reconciliation)
Current lock holder
Comment threads

post.summary: Open a thread anchored to a range

get.summary: Audit rows for this note revision
Workflow state, assignees, available events for the caller, deadlines
Transition history (newest first)

post.summary: Send an event to the machine
Duplicate the task for another revision (new instance in todo with the same assignments)

get.summary: Work queue rows for the caller (or, for assigners, another user or everyone)
Counts by state for dashboards
Bills with a hearing inside the window and no note

post.summary: Run the deadline poller now (admin, tests)

get.summary: Inbox (unread first)
Unread count for the nav badge
